Method of Attack: Denial of service via infinite loop triggered by parsing maliciously crafted certificates or private keys containing elliptic curve public keys or parameters in compressed form
Certificate parsing prior to signature verification allows DoS attack
Impacted Systems: Hosting providers taking certificates or private keys from customers
Certificate authorities parsing certification requests from subscribers
Any system parsing ASN.1 elliptic curve parameters
Attack Vector: Parsing of maliciously crafted certificates or private keys with compressed elliptic curve parameters
